knowledge_graph.title: Coronavirus Lambda variant
knowledge_graph.description: The Lambda variant, also known as lineage C.37, is a variant of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19. It was first detected in Peru in August 2020. On 14 June 2021, the World Health Organization named it Lambda variant and designated it as a variant of interest.
